newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Columbus Stainless cause of concern - Gencor.
newsitem.headline: Columbus Stainless cause of concern - Gencor.

text.p: Production problems at Columbus Stainless were proving a worry to Gencor Ltd, chairman Brian Gilbertson said on Monday.
Speaking at a presentation of Gencor's results for the year ended June 30, he said:
"A new area of concern is Columbus. It is proving much more difficult to commission than we thought at the outset...It is not yet at the position where it is operating smoothly."
The operation's technical problems, particularly in the hot mill section, have been compounded by depressed international prices for stainless steel.

Since official project completion last September, Gencor and its partners Highveld Steel and Vanadium Corp Ltd and the state-run Industrial Development Corp have had to capitalise an additional 500 million rand in the operation.
The original budget for Columbus was 3.5 billion rand.
Gilbertson said contined funding was likely to be needed until full capacity was reached, which management now expected to take place during 1998.
